title: Traditional symbolism of major palm lines
text: In some palmistry traditions, the heart line is interpreted symbolically in relation to emotions and relationships. Such interpretations are cultural beliefs rather than validated measurements of personality or relationship outcomes.

title: Traditional symbolism of the head line
text: Some palmistry traditions associate the head line with thinking style and decision-making. The appearance of a palm line does not establish a person's cognitive ability, intelligence, or future decisions.

title: Traditional symbolism of the life line
text: The life line is sometimes interpreted in palmistry as a symbol of vitality or major life themes. It cannot reliably determine lifespan, diagnose health conditions, or predict medical outcomes.

title: Traditional symbolism of the fate line
text: In some palmistry traditions, the fate line is associated with career direction or perceived life changes. It cannot establish whether someone will receive a promotion, become wealthy, or experience a particular career event.

title: Limits of palmistry predictions
text: Palmistry is a traditional interpretive practice. Palm lines are not a scientifically validated basis for predicting future events. Readings should be presented as cultural symbolism or entertainment, with uncertainty and appropriate limits.
